claim_status: Scoped external provider docs and selected bounded case study evidence, NOT live user billing, verified performance or universal best hosting

claims.claim: Cloudflare Workers paid account base is $5 per month, inclusive of 10 million requests and 30 million CPU-ms with different excess meters.
claims.caveat: Does not include other Cloudflare services or negotiated account contracts.
claims.scope: Specific vendor product/account, time and plan; does not infer actual costs, task success, or a 1M MAU load test.

claims.claim: Cloudflare Workers Paid incremental requests $0.30 per million and CPU $0.02 per million CPU-milliseconds in Standard usage model.
claims.caveat: 2026 Standard Workers model only, not heavy transcode container compute.
claims.scope: Specific vendor product/account, time and plan; does not infer actual costs, task success, or a 1M MAU load test.

claims.claim: Workers have 128 MB memory per isolate including JS heap and Wasm; Worker can handle concurrent invocations.
